protocol.grain_scope: Cadence only; full declared physical count state with hardware
limitations: Coarse count states, not microscopic thermal baseline
Hardware loss disables powered repair only; substitutes remain
Fast/slow contrast changes paired repair law; pre-fault root matches
Left adaptation only; right capacity one
External one-way faults are not equilibrium thermal events
Same boundary prescription does not imply equal accepted work
Apparatus not established valuers; no protection reward; randomness counts

predictions.C1: At least one primary horizon has different winning response between fast and hardware_loss at hazard .02
predictions.H1: Service response never decreases over adjacent horizons; strict increases counted separately
predictions.R1: At least one mode/horizon shows greater service response when hazard rises .02 to .04

protocol.rate_scope: Secondary sustained breadth diagnostic; no offset estimate in this batch
protocol.recovery_scope: Restore original left active reserve >=2; firsthit/endpoint/retention distinct
protocol.root_scope: Same pre-fault physical root; post_fault conditional on one left fault is diagnostic
protocol.service_order: Pointwise service coefficient on feasible active>0 left (a,w), capacity3
protocol.tie_scoring: Compare all tied winner pairs; mixed or incomparable outcomes retained

interpretation.primary: winner ranking uses complete-history bits at present root, separately at each horizon
interpretation.post_fault: post-fault root scores are reported alongside the primary and are not substituted for it
interpretation.physical_readouts: stock, exposure, function, hardware, damage, recovery and costs are descriptive readouts, not optimizer rewards
interpretation.hardware_loss: broken hardware disables local powered repair; basal substitutes remain, so closure is read from transitions/readouts
interpretation.contrasts: mode contrasts hold hazard and cadence fixed; hazard contrasts hold mode and cadence fixed
interpretation.ties: canonical policy ties use absolute tolerance 1e-08; service is compared as a partial order on common feasible local observations with active>0 and active+worn<=3
